name: FPS Calculator
tagline: Predicts real-world gaming FPS for any CPU + GPU combo across 50+ AAA titles.
description: Predicts gaming frame rates for any CPU + GPU combination across 50+ AAA titles at 1080p, 1440p, and 4K — using a calibrated Amdahl frame-time model backed by real benchmark data. FastAPI + PostgreSQL backend with Alembic migrations and hardware-score caching; React 19 + Vite + Tailwind frontend with i18n via i18next. Deployed with Coolify blue-green on Docker behind a Cloudflare tunnel, with CI via GitHub Actions.

name: Pixlyzer
tagline: Professional media suite — image conversion, PDF tools, and AI upscaling.
description: Full-stack media processing suite live at pixlyzer.com. Handles client-side image conversion (HEIC, AVIF, PNG, JPEG) via WebAssembly (@jsquash) with zero server round-trips for basic ops, plus server-side AI upscaling via Real-ESRGAN on Replicate and background removal via Celery workers. FastAPI + SQLite backend with Clerk auth; pyvips and pypdfium2 for server-side processing.

name: Minxlink
tagline: Link management platform — short URLs, analytics dashboard, geo-routing, and payments.
description: Multi-tenant link management platform at minxl.ink. Shortens URLs with custom slugs and tracks clicks with a full analytics dashboard (Recharts). Supports geo-based routing, device routing, A/B test splits, and Cloudflare KV for edge redirects. Clerk for multi-tenant auth, Razorpay for subscription payments, Svix for webhook delivery. FastAPI + PostgreSQL + Redis backend.

name: Bottleneck Calculator
tagline: See exactly how much your CPU bottlenecks your GPU — and what to upgrade.
description: Estimates CPU/GPU bottleneck percentage for gaming builds and recommends balanced upgrades. React 19 + Vite + Tailwind frontend with Recharts visualisations and i18next localisation; FastAPI + PostgreSQL + SQLAlchemy backend with rate limiting via slowapi. Shares benchmark dataset infrastructure with the FPS Calculator.

name: MSDL
tagline: Download official Windows ISOs directly from Microsoft's CDN — no MCT, no account.
description: Open-source tool that fetches official Windows ISO download links straight from Microsoft's CDN, bypassing the Media Creation Tool entirely. Supports 38 languages and ARM64/x64/x86. React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind v4 frontend deployed via GitHub Pages; Go backend using stdlib net/http with RWMutex session caching and a separate legacy Python backend.

name: SkySift
tagline: India aviation intelligence — live flight tracking, price discovery, AI route insights.
description: Real-time aviation intelligence platform for the Indian market at skysift.in. Pulls live data from OpenSky Network, AeroDataBox, and Aviationstack via APScheduler polling; visualises it on Mapbox GL; and generates AI route insights using the Claude API. FastAPI + PostgreSQL + Redis + asyncpg backend; React 18 + TypeScript + Zustand state frontend.

name: WinPerfMon
tagline: One dark-themed app to replace Task Manager, HWiNFO, GPU-Z, and Wireshark.
description: Native Windows performance monitor built with .NET 8 and WinUI 3. Four-project architecture — App (UI), Collector (polling worker), Shared (models), Storage (SQLite ring buffer). Real-time charts via LiveChartsCore; hardware metrics via LibreHardwareMonitor; up to 30 days of history. Replaces a stack of third-party monitoring tools with one cohesive experience.
